newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GITIC makes bid for Hualing at HK$0.80/shr.
newsitem.headline: GITIC makes bid for Hualing at HK$0.80/shr.

text.p: Guangzhou International Trust and Investment Corp (GITIC) said on Wednesday it will make an unconditional cash offer for all the issued shares of Hualing Holdings Ltd at HK$0.80 per share.
GITIC, which is making the bid through its Whiteside Holdings Ltd unit, said it intended to hold its Hualing stake as a long-term investment and maintain listing of the shares.

The GITIC group, together with Baiyun Agriculture Industry Commerce Corp, Guangzhou Light Industrial Products Import & Export (Group) Corp, Hi-Q Home Appliance Co Ltd, have a total 565.46 million shares in Hualing, representing about 70.68 percent of the company's issued capital.
Hualing makes and sells refrigerators, airconditioners, sterilisation cabinets and airconditioner compressers.
